scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix web" "npm run dev --prefix api"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix web && npm run build --prefix api
scripts.start: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run start --prefix web" "npm run start --prefix api"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix web && npm install --prefix api
